remarks: 1111 Elmwood is perfectly located steps from the AKG, walk over to The Terrace in Delaware Park for brunch or happy hour cocktails, and enjoy all the restaurants and shops along Elmwood Avenue. This city condo faces the backyard, and has an expansive private outdoor space. The condo faces Southeast and gets beautiful sunlight all day and night. The layout features 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a gas fireplace. The ceilings are 10 feet high, there's a great open concept layout, and in-unit laundry room. The terrace has electrical outlets and a hose bib for the urban garden of your dreams. All of the the condos are all fully custom built to your taste - you get to choose your cabinets, flooring, appliances, etc. The building has a Full-time concierge, 24/7 Attended desk, Resident Fitness Studio, 2 Shared outdoor spaces, EV charging stations, and each unit comes with 2 parking spaces in the underground parking garage. You'll never need to brush snow off your car in the morning again! Square footage based on planned/built dimensions. Come check us out!
